source: Prospective engineering bound and read-only provider metadata only. No synthetic or physical optimizer result, availability claim, job ID or invoice.
decision: Only Main may release the V3 pilot; no V2/V2.1 dispatch. No paid resources, reservations, builders, GPU calls, TEST bytes or cloud uploads created in establishing this route. Parallel studies share one incremental gross limit of $25, no reset; normal aggregate target <=$15, no minimum spending target.
science_and_payload: Use only immutable v3 split.json, design.json, stream-release-1.json, training-release-1.json, public pilot-packet.json (identical to private packet.json) and the ten matching pilot-subset receipt hashes. Full stream-summary.json is separate, not required or substituted. The split has 8192 TRAIN / 8192 TEST rows per beta; the timing packet has 64 true screen TRAIN parents per beta, all ten, no TEST rows. Freeze the exact commit of full_hero_v3_pilot.py, full_hero_train.py and hero_train.py, never later working copies. Return model.npz and summary.json (or a sanitized error <=8 KiB with exception class, fixed category labels, code filenames and frame line numbers, never free-form stderr). Pilot has 256 actual CUDA optimizer updates and 2 numeric check updates. Read output for real device/steps/measurements; do not estimate GPU time from CPU or a reservation.

resource_contract.model: NVIDIA H100 SXM 80GB, one whole device; plain H100 permits H200 substitution. Worker rejects incorrect name/count, CC or visible memory; billed resource classified separately after stop.
resource_contract.image_evidence: ImageFromId from previous completed app's layout: torch 2.5.1+cu124 / numpy 1.26.4 / scipy 1.14.1 / Python 3.11.10 under /opt/conda; pinned base pytorch/pytorch sha256:c8268a92a69bd500f8be0e665b2630ee006dadaf7bfbc24249141b15ff622755 has no entrypoint. Look up directly by immutable ID only. No new image build, layers, download, snapshot, volumes, auxiliary compute or data from the old App.

at_most_once: Object name unique, one local irreversible shared ledger reservation before first mutation. No trainer/data/armed command at boot. Single explicit post-start exec tied to cached task ID and generated process ID (SDK 1.6.4 describes it as an idempotency key/process identifier). Only this process sees the one-use 32-byte capability on stdin and a spent marker claimed O_EXCL. No network, restore or controller retry/resubmission on any failure or uncertain create/exec. Absolute UTC command expiry, server exec timeout AND whole-object lifetime. Explicit terminate(wait=True) for this sandbox only. A fresh worker boot cannot autonomously optimize. We do not claim no hardware loss/migration; an interrupted run can have no scientific result. This is not a Function input to which Function retry semantics apply. No snapshot, writable Volume, egress-enabled sidecar, OIDC, tunnel, region surcharge, public endpoint or persistent disk.
io_model: SDK file service, no workload-initiated outbound network. Only local, hash-checked regular files: <=64MiB packet, <=64KiB manifest, 3x <=256KiB source. Both command streams DEVNULL; no user stdout/stderr bytes. Only stat-checked regular result pair, <=128KiB aggregate, fetched once and rehashed. Reserve 1GiB at full egress tariff even counting ingress and allowing large protocol margin (>15x total application bytes). No external network actions or downloads; base image already present, no disk increase, no ongoing retained study storage. SDK metadata transports are not user-created network workloads.

gross_budget.rates_from_authenticated_sdk: H100 $3.95/h; sandbox CPU $0.1419/core-h; memory $0.024/GiB-h; network $0.04/GiB. No allowances, credits, discounts or tax assumptions used as headroom.
gross_budget.conservative_model: 300/3600*(3*3.95 + .1419 + 4*.024) + .04 = 1.047325. Whole 300s including boot/load/idle/output charged at all fixed maxima; even apply 3x to GPU for sensitivity though GPU table refers to standard pricing. CPU/RAM already sandbox rates. No second object, image build or retained data SKU. Round up to 1.05.
gross_budget.gross_not_net: Local lock is exclusivity, not a charge or a provider hard-dollar setting. No handoff to large batch until attributable actuals, resource identity and timing, inclusive plan and separate cap are registered. No credit for missing metering or early exit. No second launch by this CLI.

reconciliation: Capture exact sandbox/app IDs privately and transaction times; publish successful or failed pilot receipt without private input. Poll known object only; SandboxStats contains per-resource *estimated* cost and billed CPU/RAM; check provider GPU seconds/class and hourly App-level gross rows, including egress, allowing billing lag. No new create on timeout; unknown object resolves read-only by named sandbox under exact study App. Keep hold on unresolved bill, never rearm this pilot. No other App stopped or shared limit changed. Numerical first CUDA step is observable only in worker output; ID/arm is not evidence of one step.
alternate_workspace: Only one configured profile, owner role but shared preexisting workload and noncompute use. Both environments deny budget access and Environment limits are compute-only. Workspace summary gives metered/billed totals, not accepted pre-credit limit. No independent dedicated workspace identified; unauthenticated settings redirect to sign-in; no authenticated browser relay. Alternative requires Owner/Manager to verify dedicated pre-credit workspace gross usage budget <= remaining $25 at clean baseline, current cycle and all ancillary charges, with no unrelated simultaneous work, fees, paid plan or rollover; if UI minimum exceeds available budget obtain provider adjustment. No shared workspace changes and no claim that Starter credits enforce a gross cap.
